summary: BioCardia filed a routine Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing via press release the completion of a revised Pre-Submission to the FDA Center for Devices and Radiological Health under the Q-Submission program seeking approval of its Helix Catheter for therapeutic and diagnostic agent delivery to the heart. No financial, ownership, or transactional terms were disclosed. The filing is a regulatory milestone update, not a corporate event such as a merger, tender offer, spin-off, or restructuring. It carries no arbitrage angle and serves only as a pipeline and regulatory-progress data point for equity research.
